0427231d1ce5c3c369a3c3b216f1952410a3a6f1.name: BiMetricSummary
0427231d1ce5c3c369a3c3b216f1952410a3a6f1.query: query BiMetricSummary($metricKey: BiMetricKey!, $filters: BiMetricFiltersInput) { biMetric(metricKey: $metricKey, filters: $filters) { metricKey generatedAt summary { value label unit } points { key label value secondaryValue } } }

e7aef47ab2aa97275b75211f97ab036defd0d8ac.name: DashboardRead
e7aef47ab2aa97275b75211f97ab036defd0d8ac.query: query DashboardRead($id: ID!, $filters: BiMetricFiltersInput) { biDashboard(id: $id) { id title isPublic widgets { id title metricKey } } biDashboardData(id: $id, filters: $filters) { dashboardId generatedAt widgets { result { metricKey summary { value label unit } } } } }
